description: This file contains Python code defining templates and functions for generating markdown documentation for plugins, including sections for headers, methods, properties, events, and examples. It is used to produce structured markdown documentation for Thunder framework plugins based on input data.

methods.name: to_camel_case
methods.description: Convert UpperCamelCase to lowerCamelCase.

methods.name: generate_header_toc
methods.description: Generate the header table of contents for the markdown file.

methods.name: generate_header_description_markdown
methods.description: Generate the header description markdown for the file.

methods.name: generate_configuration_options_section
methods.description: Generate the configuration options section for the markdown file.

methods.name: generate_methods_toc
methods.description: Generate the methods table of contents for the markdown file.

methods.name: flatten_canonical_dict
methods.description: Flatten a canonical dict for table output, returning list of (name, type, description) tuples.

methods.name: generate_request_section
methods.description: Generate the request section for a method, converting method names and serializing to JSON.

methods.name: generate_curl_request_section
methods.description: Generate the curl request section for a method, converting method names and serializing to JSON.

methods.name: generate_response_section
methods.description: Generate the response section for a method, serializing response to JSON.

methods.name: generate_parameters_section
methods.description: Generate the parameters section for a method, including descriptions and optionality.

methods.name: generate_results_section
methods.description: Generate the results section for a method, including descriptions.

methods.name: generate_errors_section
methods.description: Generate the errors section for a method.

methods.name: generate_method_markdown
methods.description: Generate markdown documentation for a specific method, including examples.

methods.name: generate_events_section
methods.description: Generate the events section for a method.

methods.name: generate_properties_toc
methods.description: Generate the properties table of contents.

methods.name: generate_property_markdown
methods.description: Generate markdown for a specific property, including examples.

methods.name: generate_values_section
methods.description: Generate the values section for a property.

methods.name: generate_notifications_toc
methods.description: Generate the notifications table of contents.

methods.name: generate_notification_markdown
methods.description: Generate markdown for a specific event notification.

methods.name: _convert_json_types
methods.description: Recursively convert string numbers and boolean strings to proper types in JSON data.
